title: Oxygen-conditioned flow control needs explicit spatial, sensing, work and mechanical interfaces

scientific_scope_status: In the locally Newtonian extraction-bed model, p/kappa=q*A(M/q), and nondecreasing oxygen-dependent viscosity gives differential gain1<=E=2-g/A<=2; uniform low viscosity dominates at fixed pressure. Spatially localized resistance can change that bound but raises separate pressure/information requirements. The successor is a proposed periodically driven Maxwell transmission H=i*omega*tau/[beta+i*omega*tau*(1+beta)] with opposed metering ports. Static-preload creep cannot reopen a gate; the periodic device needs real sensing, balanced forces, delivery floor, work and reset/cyclic stability.
